ResearchProjectDef.label: combustion vehicles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rebuild pre-war combustion engines, gearboxes and wheels into working ground vehicles: cars, armoured pickups and cargo haulers that carry colonists and goods across the map and the wasteland.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Vertibird tilt-rotors
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reverse-engineer pre-war tilt-rotor VTOL turbines, armored airframes and flight avionics to assemble Brotherhood-grade Vertibirds capable of rapid world-map airlifts and close fire support.
